# psi <sprite> <file.psi> <x> <y>          (offset from the sprite's top-left)
# light <sprite> <rrggbbaa> <x> <y> <ground 0/1> <top 0/1> <scale>  (offset from the cell)
psi cg_campfire_0.png campfire.psi 20 8
light cg_campfire_0.png e25822c8 0 16 1 0 1.0
psi cg_lamp_0.png small_light_embers.psi 27 3
